item.text:
Implemented native React/Next.js view transitions across the gallery:

- Product thumbnails morph into their matching detail hero using product-specific shared transition names in [ProductGrid.tsx](/workspace/app/ProductGrid.tsx:15) and [page.tsx](/workspace/app/product/[slug]/page.tsx:62).
- Grid-to-detail navigation slides forward; the back link slides in the reverse direction.
- Suspense skeletons smoothly exit while loaded content fades/slides into place.
- `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` disables route, morph, reveal, and skeleton pulse animations in [globals.css](/workspace/app/globals.css:216).
- Unsupported browsers gracefully fall back to normal navigation.

Validation passed:

- `npm run build`
- `npx tsc --noEmit --incremental false`
- `git diff --check`
